segments.text: The home directory holds a binary called bandit twenty do, a setuid helper owned by bandit twenty: anything it runs, it runs as bandit twenty.
I log in as bandit19 with ssh bandit19@bandit.labs.overthewire.org -p 2220.
The helper simply executes whatever command you give it, so I run it with cat on bandit twenty's password file.
The helper runs the command as bandit twenty, so it can read a file my account cannot, and the password for bandit twenty prints, and the level is solved.
